messages.content: amar ekta content series shuru korte chai, kivabe plan korবো theme ta
Prothome bhabo tomar audience er sobcheye common question ba struggle ki, series ta oi around e build koro.
amar audience mostly beginner creator der question kore
Tahole ekta "beginner creator FAQ" type series khub relevant hobe - protita episode e ekta specific common question address koro. Structured ar predictable hole audience ashar moto follow korte pare.
koto episode diye shuru kora uchit?

5-6 ta core question diye shuru koro, oita test kore dekho response kemon ashe. Valo response paile extend koro, na paile format adjust koro - overcommit na kore small scale e test kora better, eta approach amar kache always safer lage.
